Full queries/defer/refresh sums and full_complete equal original H128 columns bytevalue; short_queries<=full_queries and nonnegative per-arm short<=full sums.

short_complete means observed through capture+32; full_complete through capture+128. Primary analysis uses known-history movement-labelled rows with BOTH complete, matching existing eligibility. population.primary: Natural ground Materials only: family0, movement0..7, shared natural seed adapter; Markets/private suppliers/AIR excluded. Closest scope to old resource model, not exact old oracle equivalence.
population.secondary: Each family separately (Materials,Markets,Guard,Clear,Forbidden), with movement class ground/AIR separate; absent family explicitly unmeasured. No pooled label ratio advertised as old resource-policy conversion.
population.weights: Existing equal format/role/cohort/map/family/collection/episode hierarchy, recomputed per declared population. Collector role/cohort is diagnostic metadata, not a training cohort. Report equal-map and individual-map summaries because there are only3maps.
population.grouping: Persistent heldout map_group identities retained; no development fitting or hyperparameter selection.

estimands.distribution: Paired weighted means/medians/p10/p25/p75/p90, min/max and per-map values for B32/B128/Blate, Q32/Q128/Qlate. Report raw and weighted count B32>=32.
estimands.rates: B32/24 versus B128/120 per usable tick; per-query B32/Q32 and B128/Q128 only when denominators positive, explicit undefined otherwise. Query-rate change reported independently.
estimands.ratios: B128/B32 summarized ONLY B32>0, weighted median/IQR/p10/p90. B32=0, B32<0 and sign flips reported separately; ratios undefined for nonpositive short labels, no dropping these from other summaries.
estimands.scaling_failures: Sign-transition matrix B32<0/=0/>0 against B128<0/=0/>0; count late-only gains (B32<=0,B128>0), reversals (B32>0,B128<=0), and late cancellations Blate<0.

conditional_band.summary: B128 weighted median/IQR/p10/p90 and raw counts/maps; fixed bands reported separately, no outcome-driven widening
conditional_band.low_support: If belowminimum, label insufficient support; show raw summaries only, do not state an empirical equivalent cutoff.

estimands.oracle_cutoff: Descriptive only: find integer B128 cutoff whose weighted P(B128>=c) best matches P(B32>=32); candidate unique B128 values and max+1, ties choose largest cutoff. No random splitting of tied labels. Report achieved fraction error, weighted FP/FN/disagreement and per-map results for this rate-matched cutoff plus fixed128 and160. If target fraction0or1, report boundary/nonidentification rather than unique equivalent. No fit or threshold recommendation.

uncertainty.unit: whole map cluster, paired across both horizons
uncertainty.method: Exact multinomial bootstrap distribution over3maps with equal sample size3, all10 count vectors and their multinomial probabilities. Fixed hierarchy weights; weighted percentile95 intervals for paired mean benefit differences, conditional median and descriptive rate-matched cutoff only where defined; no refitting.
uncertainty.seed: No RNG needed: exhaustive map-count enumeration
uncertainty.limitations: Only3clusters; intervals discrete and fragile, report each map and support, avoid significance or deployment claims. Sensitivity of rate-matched cutoff to leaving each map out reported descriptively, not used to select.
uncertainty.incomplete_map_handling: Expected3maps. If fewer maps yield complete paired rows, report map-level censoring and enumerate corresponding exact n-map bootstrap; no CI from1map, no replacement. Conditional band minimumsupport still applies.
